result.description:
Gilmac, Australia's top hay exporter, handles a quarter of the country's hay exports across three states, with major markets in Japan, Korea, and Taiwan.

 

We are seeking a qualified Electrician to support our hay processing plant operations, based out of our Midvale workshop travelling regionally to sites in Wagin, York and New Norcia to support routine weekly preventative maintenance while also contributing during planned shutdown maintenance and other plant upgrades. 

 

Responsibilities

Schedule and perform routine electrical maintenance on automated hay press, conveyors, strapping equipment, packaging machinery and associated plant systems.

Diagnose and repair electrical faults on fixed plant, motors, sensors, control panels, drives and ancillary equipment.

Assist with breakdown response, planned shutdowns and preventative maintenance across site equipment.

Support troubleshooting of PLC-controlled plant and coordinate contractor support where required.

Maintain electrical records, maintenance database updates and action registers.

Manage stock levels for electrical parts and critical spares.

Work with site and maintenance teams to improve plant uptime, safety, quality and continuous improvement outcomes.

Ensure all electrical work is completed safely and in accordance with Gilmac procedures, isolation requirements and relevant standards.

 

Skills & Experience:

Australian electrical trade qualification and relevant electrical licence/registration.

Experience in industrial, manufacturing, agricultural, processing or fixed plant environments.

Fault finding and maintenance experience across motors, sensors, conveyors, control systems, drives and automated machinery.

PLC, instrumentation, automation or packaging equipment experience would be highly regarded.

Ability to read electrical drawings and apply safe isolation and testing practices.

 

Requirements

Full-time availability and flexibility for after-hours callouts if needed.

Commitment to safety, quality, preventative maintenance and reliable plant operation.

Willingness to learn Gilmac plant systems and support practical improvements across our sites.

Ability to work independently or in a small team.

Current driver’s licence.

Pass pre-employment physical and medical tests, including alcohol and drug screening.



Remuneration: 

Salary package $130,000-$140,000 dependent on experience

To apply send resume to hr@gilmac.com.au
result.title: Electrician

All Forklifts & Equipment are a friendly, independent, fast-paced and rapidly growing company specialising in the hire, service and repair of material handling equipment, primarily forklifts.

Due to our rapid growth, we require several Small Engine Mechanics and Diesel Motor Mechanics to join our team on a permanent basis to service and maintain our fleet of equipment, and perform retail maintenance, service and repairs.

- Reassembling engines and parts after being repaired
- Repairing and replacing worn and defective parts, reassembling mechanical components, and referring to service manuals as needed
- Performing scheduled maintenance services, such as oil changes, lubrications and engine tune-ups to achieve smoother running of vehicles and ensure compliance with pollution regulations
- Testing and adjusting mechanic parts after being repaired for proper performance
- Diagnosing and testing parts with the assistance of computers
- Perform operational safety checks
- May inspect vehicles and issue roadworthiness certificates or detail work required to achieve roadworthiness
- May respond to vehicle breakdown service calls
- Provide customers with technical and operational advice

A salary between $78,000 - $80,000 will be offered to the successful applicants.

Apply now through our online application form -
https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17529.php

Sponsorship may be available to the right candidate.

Global Vision Recruitment on behalf of ABC Trading Pty Ltd T/A Five Star Car Care

Date Posted: 30 June 2026

Position: Motor Mechanic (General) 

Employment Type: Full-Time (38 hours per week) 

Salary: AUD $80,000 – $95,000 per annum plus superannuation

Hours: 38 hours per week

Location: 5a Kurrajong Road, North St Marys NSW 2760

About the Role

ABC Trading is seeking a skilled and motivated Motor Mechanic (General) to join our team in North St Marys, NSW. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, servicing, repairing, and maintaining a variety of motor vehicles while ensuring high standards of workmanship, safety, and customer satisfaction.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

•	Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults using appropriate testing and diagnostic equipment.

•	Perform routine vehicle servicing and maintenance.

•	Repair and replace defective components including engines, transmissions, steering, suspension, braking, and electrical systems.

•	Conduct vehicle inspections and identify repair and maintenance requirements.

•	Test vehicles after repairs to ensure roadworthiness and compliance with manufacturer specifications.

•	Maintain accurate records of repairs, services, and parts used.

•	Ensure all work is completed in accordance with workplace health and safety standards.

•	Communicate effectively with customers and team members regarding vehicle issues and repair requirements.

Essential Requirements

•	An AQF Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or a closely related qualification.

•	Minimum one (1) year of relevant work experience as a Motor Mechanic.

•	Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills.

•	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

•	Good communication and organisational skills.

•	Current driver's licence is desirable.

Interested applicant may submit their resume and cover letter to recruit@gvrc.com.au. Please note that only shortlisted candidate will be contacted.
